chunks: And Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Inform me about what سجود is permitted upon and what is not permitted.
He said: "Sujūd is not permissible except upon the earth or upon what the earth grows, except that which is eaten or worn."

key_terms.أَنْبَتَتِ: that which the earth causes to grow
key_terms.أُكِلَ: that which is eaten, excluded from valid prostration surfaces
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth or ground as a valid surface of prostration
key_terms.لُبِسَ: that which is worn, excluded from valid prostration surfaces

ai.seo_question: What materials are permissible for sajdah in salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling regarding the valid surface for sajdah in salat (prayer). Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام limits permissibility to the earth and what grows from it, while excluding items that are normally eaten or worn.
